name: Bryant Park Mah Jongg Social
description: Free weekly Mah Jongg social in Bryant Park, Midtown Manhattan. Official Bryant Park calendar: "players play the National Mah Jongg League style"; beginners to experts welcome, basic game knowledge required; tiles, racks and cards provided. Teaching table reported 5-7pm. Historically a warm-weather series - confirm it is running in winter.
schedule: Thursdays (hours not on main page; JTA reports 3-7pm in summer; seasonal status unconfirmed)

name: Congregation Rodeph Sholom Mah Jongg Class
description: Upper West Side synagogue's Mah Jongg class: "An introduction to American-style Mah Jongg for the brand-new player or those looking for a refresher." Three consecutive days plus an optional bi-weekly game day; limited to 8; taught by members of the CRS Mah Jongg Advisory Council. Last confirmed price Free for members / $154 non-members (2025 listing).
